name: Screw It
storyline:
Your package has arrived. But what arrived was 777 loose nails and 1 screw, thrown into a box with barely any thought given to what would happen next. Different sizes, damaged, and dirty nails are all mixed together in one giant mess. Some are perfectly fine, while others are bent, rusty, or broken.

You filed a complaint, but nothing happened. No need to worry. Now all you have to do is calm down, relax, walk up to the quiet workbench, and sort all 777 nails and find the 1 screw, putting everything into its proper place in peace.
summary: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.
